title: Which government will form after the 2026 New Zealand general election?
resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve according to the New Zealand government following the 2026 parliamentary elections based on the following criteria:

* **Labour-led**, if the government formed is led by the Labour Party irrespective of which other parties are in coalition.
* **National-led**, if the government formed is led by the National Party, irrespective of which other parties are in coalition.
* **Other**, if the government formed is led by a party other than the Labour or National Party.

If no government is formed before January 2027, this question will resolve as **None before January**.

The New Zealand Government will be the primary source for resolution, such as the seating plan for the 55th Parliament.
fine_print: Transitional/caretaker governments will not qualify for this question.
